dominant_strengths: Crisp geometric sans wordmark and tight headline tracking establish confident, developer-tool authority on a pure black canvas
The prismatic spectrum behind the triangle logo creates a striking focal hero that ties brand mark to product narrative
Restrained chrome — pill nav, mono CTAs, faint grid — keeps the eye locked on the centered headline and primary action
dominant_weaknesses: Headline 'Build and deploy on the AI Cloud.' is generic copy that undercuts the visual ambition and distinctiveness
Two CTAs sit at near-equal weight under low contrast; 'Get a Demo' dark pill recedes into the gradient and weakens hierarchy
The rainbow gradient borders on familiar SaaS-hero cliché and competes with the announcement bar above for attention
fix_priorities: Sharpen the H1 with a more specific, opinionated value claim that earns the dramatic stage
Increase contrast/weight differentiation between primary and secondary CTAs to clarify path
Push the prism/triangle composition further — motion or asymmetry — to escape generic gradient-hero territory
rationale.norman_balance: Strong visceral hit from the prism logo, solid behavioral clarity via centered CTA, but reflective payoff is thin because the messaging is boilerplate.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it reads unmistakably as Vercel's developer-cloud marketing home, faithful to brand system though not pushing it forward.
